== Summary ==
Identified: [[Dan Tartaglione]] (black Players Committee polo, at the black bag; same clothing as the embroidered-name stills and [[:File:2021 World Championship between rounds 6.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled.
Players gathered between rounds. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).
